Alice is about to speedrun from [Ordinary Rock] to [God]. 

When Alice Merryweather died, she was told she could reincarnate as any animal she wanted.

She chose to become a rock.

Unable to move, speak, or even see beyond a few feet, she has only one way to survive: spread curses, harvest cursed energy, and evolve into something worthy of both worship and fear.

As her power grows, so too does her influence. It isn't long before the remnants of an evil cult find her and mistake her for the vessel of their dark god. Their worship unlocks the [Divine Development] system, allowing Alice to answer prayers, perform miracles, and build her own religion.

Alice only ever wanted to live a quiet life as a rock. She never imagined she would become an object of worship... or a vessel of the world's destruction.
